title: Uniformly convex stalks and Kucher's $\ell_{\infty}(E)$ problem
summary: Kucher asked whether $\ell_{\infty}(E)$ is a Grothendieck space for every super-reflexive Banach space $E$. We answer this question affirmatively by proving the stronger result that $\ell_{\infty}(E)$ has Pełczyński's property $(V)$. Combined with the natural dual representation of $\ell_{\infty}(E)$, this yields that every non-weakly compact operator on $\ell_{\infty}(E)$ fixes a copy of $\ell_{\infty}$.
